facts.fact: 清早露台：Simon 看起来疲惫、像哭过；Orson 与他昨夜大吵后离开，他说这次大概真的结束了。
facts.anchor: No, please, I’m grateful for the company.

facts.fact: 金发男子自报 Dickie Soames，并以 private 重读刺 Olivia；他认出她是 Peter Madden 的女儿，又暗示苹果没掉远。
facts.anchor: We met yesterday? In Rex’s private library?

facts.fact: Olivia 看见 Dickie 胸袋里露出和 Lundy 盘问时相似的笔记本，立刻把 Richard 对上 Mr. Tattletale。
facts.anchor: A notebook like the one Constable Lundy had written in

facts.fact: Tamsin 故意大声问「那是谁」，把 Dickie 引向 Léonide Massine；Simon 说 Massine 接替 Nijinsky、为 Cocteau 做过有 Picasso 服装的芭蕾。
报纸头条：失踪作家 Maurice Kelville 的遗体在 Porthmeor Cove 被当地渔民发现。
facts.anchor: BODY OF MISSING AUTHOR WASHES UP IN PORTHMEOR COVE

facts.fact: 报道给出 Kelville 43 岁；尸体受自然力量严重损毁，由家人凭剩下那只手上的 signet ring 确认身份。
警方口径：无人目击，但已排除 foul play；推测他在暴雨后崖边塌陷时坠崖身亡。
facts.anchor: There were no witnesses to this event but the police have ruled out any suspicion of foul play.

facts.fact: Simon 的危机处理：两人什么都别做；若被迫与 Dickie 交谈就善待他，因为他挡不住漂亮脸；并警告把 sapphic shenanigans 留给更有经验的 Tallulah。
facts.anchor: As little as possible. You’ve already done enough to keep Mr. Tattletale busy for a week.
